history.summary: A 1,216 sqft 3BR freehold at $1.85M / $1,521 PSF in D12 Boon Keng (TOP 2005, ~910m to Boon Keng MRT). The headline 6.0%/yr appreciation rests on only 3 URA transactions so is unreliable, but the asking PSF sits ~12.5% above the $1,352 median, and the $1.85M quantum lands in a liquid band.
history.rating_rationale: The fundamentals are middling-positive: freehold, a healthy 3BR size for families, a $1.85M quantum inside the deep $1.8-2.5M band, and a positive arena Elo (1273, 285 wins). But the 5.998%/yr URA rate is built on just 3 transactions — too thin to trust — and the $1,521 asking PSF is a meaningful ~12.5% premium to the $1,352 URA median, so the buyer is paying up. A 2005-vintage block ~910m from MRT in Boon Keng is solid city-fringe stock but not a standout; the value case is fair, not cheap.
red_flags: Appreciation rate from only 3 URA transactions — unreliable
Asking $1,521 PSF is ~12.5% above $1,352 URA median
21-year-old development — rising maintenance, no new-build appeal
910m to MRT — beyond the prime sub-500m uplift band
catalysts: Boon Keng / city-fringe proximity to CBD supports steady rental
